lines.trans: When I first joined Xingtian, I made an agreement with you.
I promised to build a mechanism for the company that could run independently.
That has been the goal of my work over the past four years.
Everything now proves that the chief editor office and all of Xingtian no longer need to rely on me.
At last I have lived up to your trust and can consider my mission complete.

words.gram: Meaning: report completion of a duty.

lines.trans: Thank you for trusting me all these years.
Chairwoman, does this now prove what I told you earlier?
Xingtian's chief editor team truly is the most capable team in the industry.
Sister Xingzi, Brother Kaiwen, and I are certainly capable enough.
However, I believe the success of this crisis response proves something else.
What it proves is not our personal ability, rather the value of the workflow Mr Chun Yuqiao left behind.
All of us hope Mr Chun Yuqiao will return to Xingtian soon.
